baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive giving of a book is completed by the locative construction behind his back.
baseline_models.mechanism: A readable object is transferred to the far side of the anatomical back, replacing ordinary frontal or hand-held reception with an obstructed receipt that the recipient cannot readily inspect or control.

activation_trace.role: The granting or bringing image supplies the transfer of the record to the recipient.
Joined letters and the written book make the transferred object inspectable information rather than an unspecified burden.
The far-side image permits a position behind, beyond, or on the other side and supplies the displacement from frontal access.
The anatomical back opposite the belly fixes the primary bodily geometry of the receipt.

changed_reading.before: A person is simply handed a book in an unusual place.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a deliberately inaccessible mode of receipt: the record reaches the person while being kept outside normal sight, grasp, and response.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Kitab can name an imposed determination or enrollment, while wara'a al-zahr can mark concealment and dismissive placement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The book is not only prose about the recipient but a binding inscription that places the recipient within a judgment or class. What could be hidden, neglected, or put behind returns passively as the very instrument that fixes status.

activation_trace.role: Inscription as binding decree turns the book from a report into an operative determination.
Entry in a register supplies the social and classificatory effect of the record.
Covering and withdrawing from sight supplies the attempted concealment that the delivery reverses.
Putting something behind the back as neglect or rejection makes the location carry a prior stance toward the record.

changed_reading.before: The book records a status already decided elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: The returned inscription performs the status it discloses: the neglected or concealed record now enrolls its recipient under an unavoidable determination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The record is located at the back, a root-domain that also carries loads and supplies backing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The site normally associated with carrying capacity, reserve, and support is occupied by a binding record. The book can therefore be carried as a load while simultaneously displacing the support on which the bearer might rely.

activation_trace.role: The image of mounts and load-bearing reserves makes the back a carrying site and turns the book into borne weight.
Backing and assistance supply the positive capacity that the rearward book can occupy or negate.
The binding determination gives the carried object coercive weight rather than neutral mass.

changed_reading.before: Behind the back signals only shame or awkward placement.
changed_reading.after: The record converts the bearer's own support-side into a load-side: what should carry or reinforce him now carries the determination against him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A binding book is given at the back, while the back-root can image turning a matter from back to belly.
baseline_models.mechanism: The placement can enact an inverted audit. Instead of the person facing and examining a document, the document arrives from the reverse side and turns the person over as the matter being examined.

activation_trace.role: Turning a matter back-to-belly supplies the reversal by which the recipient becomes the object under examination.
The firmly established judgment supplies the audit's determinative rather than merely descriptive force.
Approach through a particular access route makes the reverse-side arrival part of the mechanism, not incidental scenery.

changed_reading.before: The recipient inspects a record delivered to him.
changed_reading.after: The reverse-side record inspects and reorients the recipient, turning his hidden side into the object of judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence removes containing surfaces: the upper enclosure splits, reality is established, the lower enclosure casts out what is in it, and becomes empty. Against that sequence, the rearward book is the human-scale counterpart of contents forced from concealment into an exposed, binding form.

activation_trace.role: The focus image of covering and withdrawal supplies the enclosed human residue that the context mechanism opens.
Emergence into visibility makes the back an exposure surface rather than a successful hiding place.
The binding inscription gives the ejected contents a settled judicial form.
Splitting and opening supply the first breach of a containing boundary.
Establishing and making truth manifest turns opening into disclosure rather than random rupture.
Casting until contents lie outside supplies the directional movement from interior to exposed surface.
Emptiness after stripping away confirms that the container retains no protected interior.

structural_cues: The surah opens with an upper enclosure splitting and a lower enclosure extending, ejecting, and emptying before either book-receipt scene.
The repeated acceptance-and-right construction in 84:2 and 84:5 frames the cosmic opening as complete compliance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic opening, manifested right, ejection, emptiness, and focus concealment; I supply the macrocosm-to-person analogy that treats the book as everted human contents. A live alternative is that these are separate resurrection events with no container analogy.

changed_reading.before: The book behind the back is a concealed or rejected document returned to one person.
changed_reading.after: It is the person's inward archive everted under the same opening logic that leaves sky and earth with no sealed interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: Arduous striving can leave scratches or defacement, and what one labors toward is eventually encountered. Joined writing on the body's outer rear surface can therefore be read as the bound accumulation of the traces produced by one's own exertion.

activation_trace.role: Joining separate pieces supplies the binding of dispersed marks into one record.
The exposed outer surface gives the accumulated traces a bodily substrate at the back.
The scratch or bite-mark image converts labor from an abstract activity into a trace-producing process.
What a person meets of good or harm supplies the return of accumulated traces to their producer.

structural_cues: 84:6 repeats the labor root as agent and cognate object, making the process unusually emphatic before saying that its destination will be met.
The book scenes follow immediately after the statement of cumulative striving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arduous action, physical marking, eventual encounter, joining, and an outer back surface; I supply the arrow by which repeated marks aggregate into a book. The live alternative is an ordinary written account distinct from the body and its wear.

changed_reading.before: The book is an externally compiled dossier about a life.
changed_reading.after: The book can also be the life's own wear-pattern gathered and bound, so the recipient meets the trace his striving has already inscribed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact parallel book scene places the other record in a locus of right, force, and usable agency, followed by opened ease and return to a group of belonging. The focus location now functions as the opposite affordance: a registered status borne as rear load rather than a credential one can hold, use, and carry home.

activation_trace.role: Enrollment in a register lets the same book operate as a status-bearing credential in either outcome.
Load-bearing mounts recast the focus location as a place where status is borne without hand-held agency.
Backing and support identify what the rearward placement fails to provide despite occupying the support-side.
The right side as force and right makes the contrasted hand a locus of legitimate agency, not only a direction.
Opening and ease after difficulty supply the practical consequence of accessible receipt.
Return and arrival at an outcome supply successful onward movement after the right-hand receipt.
The group of closeness and belonging supplies the social destination enabled in the parallel sequence.

structural_cues: 84:7 and 84:10 repeat passive giving and the possessed book almost verbatim; the destination phrase is the decisive substitution.
84:8-9 attach ease, return, belonging, and joy to the hand-held branch before 84:10 opens the rearward branch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact substitution, right-side force, ease, return, and belonging; I infer that bodily location changes the book's affordance from usable credential to imposed load. The live alternative is that hand and back are outcome labels without a causal or social affordance.

changed_reading.before: The rearward position is merely the negative counterpart of right-hand receipt.
changed_reading.after: The two positions make the same registered book function differently: one can be held as authorized passage back into belonging, while the other is borne as status without agency or return.

context_deltas.mechanism: A focus branch places hidden fire in the domain of wara, and the immediate sequel moves from a call for ruin to meeting an ignited blaze. The rearward book can thus be carried as a latent ignition point: delivery of the binding decree brings concealed consequence out of its fire-stick state.

activation_trace.role: Hidden fire emerging from a fire-stick supplies the latent-to-active material transformation at the rear.
The binding decree makes the concealed tinder an operative consequence rather than free imagery.
Being overtaken by calamity supplies a darker edge to the passive arrival.
Ruin gives the activated record its immediately voiced consequence.
Encountering the heat of fire converts the latent image into bodily contact.
Ignition and blazing supply the active state toward which the hidden fire moves.

structural_cues: The call for ruin and encounter with blaze follow the focus ayah without an intervening scene.
The focus uses passive delivery, allowing the arrival itself to serve as the proposed activation event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hidden-fire focus branch, immediate ruin, fire-contact, and ignition; I infer that receiving the book activates what was latent. A live alternative is simple narrative sequence, with the fire branch of wara contributing no material causality.

changed_reading.before: The book announces a punishment that begins afterward.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the rearward book is already the concealed tinder of that consequence, and its delivery is the moment the latent decree catches.

context_deltas.mechanism: Private inward gladness is followed by the expectation of no return and then by penetrating sight. The book behind the back becomes an epistemic blind-side return: what the person housed inwardly and treated as beyond recall is reached by sight and arrives as discoverable inscription.

activation_trace.role: Hiding and withdrawal from sight supply the attempted blind spot.
Finding out and gaining access to hidden information converts the back from blind spot to discovery site.
The written book gives hidden life a legible returned form.
Concealment in the interior supplies a private layer beneath the stated gladness.
Return and diminution supply the movement the person incorrectly excludes.
Insight of the heart supplies perception capable of reaching more than a visible public surface.

structural_cues: 84:13 repeats the family-and-gladness language of 84:9 but relocates it into a prior settled state rather than a successful return.
The rejected expectation of return in 84:14 is answered directly by sustained seeing in 84:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward concealment, denied return, penetrating sight, and focus discovery; I infer that the book is the return of material kept on an epistemic blind side. A live alternative is that the prior gladness was fully public and the back remains only a bodily location.

changed_reading.before: Behind the back marks an externally imposed position of disgrace.
changed_reading.after: It also names the recipient's failed blind spot: the privately housed life he assumed would not return comes back from the side he did not monitor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wara can designate not only behind but ahead or beyond. The ordered movement from gathering into completeness and then from state to state activates a temporal reading: the book is received from the far side of the current phase, where dispersed acts have reached their completed arrangement.

activation_trace.role: The far side as behind, ahead, or beyond licenses a temporal horizon alongside the bodily rear.
Joining separate things supplies the record's completed composition from dispersed moments.
Completion and even arrangement supply the mature configuration reached on the far side of a process.
State following state supplies the temporal phases across which the record becomes complete.

structural_cues: 84:16-18 moves through twilight, night, gathering, and a completed moon before 84:19 states passage from layer or state to another.
The focus locative is lexically capable of pointing to an other side rather than only backward space.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a behind/ahead/beyond branch, completion, and state-after-state movement; I infer that the delivery comes from a later completed phase. The live alternative is that wara remains strictly anatomical here and the phase sequence only describes resurrection generally.

changed_reading.before: The book is handed from a point physically behind the recipient.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting reading hears it arriving from beyond the recipient's present phase, the completed far side where a life's dispersed pieces have become one record.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dispersed material is gathered, layers mount one over another, and riding occurs on a back. These cues sharpen the focus support-reversal into a carrier reversal: the person who appears to bear a book is actually being made to undergo the assembled layers that the book binds.

activation_trace.role: Joining piece to piece supplies assembly of the record from many phases.
Layering one thing over another places the assembled record directly in the focus back-domain.
The load-bearing image establishes the apparent relation in which the person carries the book.
Gathering dispersed things supplies the aggregation that precedes layering.
Riding on a back supplies the reversible carrier-rider relation.
One thing mounting over another connects riding to material accumulation.
Layer upon layer supplies the plural structure the bound record makes the recipient undergo.

structural_cues: Gathering in 84:17-18 is followed immediately by riding and doubled layer-language in 84:19.
The focus places the assembled object at the body part conventionally associated with bearing and being ridden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, layering, riding-on-a-back, and focus binding/load-bearing; I reverse the apparent carrier relation so the accumulated record bears down on and carries the person through its states. The live alternative is the simpler image of a person merely carrying a rearward book.

changed_reading.before: The recipient bears the book as an imposed load.
changed_reading.after: The assembled book is also what bears the recipient onward: its layer-by-layer contents become the states he must ride or undergo.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reading gathers material, denial covers it, the heart or vessel contains it, and knowledge uncovers it. The focus book can therefore be the externalized container of what the recipient had already gathered and covered inwardly: concealed content is rebound as visible writing on the outside.

activation_trace.role: Joining supplies the book's capacity to gather dispersed inner contents into a single exterior object.
Covering and withdrawal from sight supply the inward concealment that is everted.
Coming out into view supplies the exterior visibility of formerly contained material.
Gathering and assembling supply the intake by which recited material becomes internally collected.
Veiling truth supplies the active covering laid over what has been gathered.
A thing becoming uncovered to the knower supplies access that defeats the covering.
Containing meaning in the heart supplies the inward semantic archive.
Putting a thing into a vessel makes the inside-to-outside transformation materially legible.

structural_cues: 84:21-23 moves from recited material, to refusal, to covering-denial, and finally to superior knowledge of what is internally stored.
This sequence follows the book scene and supplies both an intake process and a hidden container for its contents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, veiling, inner containment, uncovering knowledge, and focus emergence; I infer an inside-to-outside transformation in which the stored content becomes the book. The live alternative is that inner storage and the written record remain parallel evidence streams rather than the same material in two forms.

changed_reading.before: The book is a record assembled outside the recipient and then placed behind him.
changed_reading.after: The book can be his own covered interior turned outward: what he gathered and contained is rebound as an exposed record at the very side used for concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final contrast coordinates intended action, fitness, recompense as repair of a crooked break, and continuity without cutting. This backlights the focus book as a test of integration: its pieces may be bound into a document while the recipient's relation to those pieces remains dislocated, unfit, and unable to be repaired into continuity.

activation_trace.role: Joining pieces supplies formal coherence to the record against which personal dislocation can be measured.
Turning a matter back-to-belly supplies the diagnostic examination of whether its parts cohere.
Intended action supplies the life-material whose integration the book tests.
Fitness of a thing supplies the criterion of whether recorded actions belong together well.
Mending a crooked fracture supplies repair as the positive alternative to dislocation.
Cutting and diminishing an extension supplies the continuity that the final negation protects and the focus outcome lacks.

structural_cues: The final exception links belief, intended acts, fitting acts, recompense, and an explicitly uncut duration.
Its positive integration stands at the surah's far end from the focus image of a bound object dislocated behind its owner.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies action, fitness, repair, continuity, focus binding, and back-to-front examination; I infer that the book diagnoses integrity rather than only totaling deeds. A live alternative is that the closing reward is contrastive but contributes no model of how the focus book functions.

changed_reading.before: The book coherently totals acts and assigns a negative result.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its very coherence exposes the recipient's incoherence: the acts bind into a record, but not into a fit and repairable self continuous with its outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps the sequence onto bodily choreography rather than only judgment. It remains anchored in the written book, anatomical back, recitation, and refusal to bend; downstream prose should present it as a possible embodied counter-orientation, not as a claim that one ritual posture mechanically causes the delivery position.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The written object meets the anatomical back rather than the recipient's front.

activation_trace.role: The written book supplies the textual object whose bodily orientation changes.
The back opposite the belly supplies the non-frontal contact surface.
Reading and recitation supply the earlier frontal textual encounter.
Bowing the head supplies the bodily response explicitly withheld in the context.

changed_reading.before: Rearward delivery is a static humiliation imposed on the recipient.
changed_reading.after: It may also answer a prior bodily refusal: the text that was not met by frontal bending later meets the same person at the back.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it lets the back's outer surface interact with the skin-opening semantics of announcement and bodily pain. It remains anchored in the focus back-surface and binding book plus the immediate announcement vocabulary; downstream prose should call it a surface analogy, not literal writing on skin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The binding record arrives on the body's rear outer surface.

activation_trace.role: The upper or outer surface makes the back available as the receiving surface of the message.
The binding inscription supplies verdict-content impressed upon that surface analogy.
News that normally opens the skin with joy supplies the expected surface reaction that the painful announcement reverses.
Painful punishment supplies the negative content of the reversed announcement.
Bodily pain makes the surface reversal felt rather than merely informational.

changed_reading.before: The book communicates a verdict to the mind while its position marks disgrace.
changed_reading.after: As a contained surface analogy, the verdict reaches the outer back like anti-glad-tidings: a message whose bodily opening is pain rather than a brightened face.

strongest_changes: The opening and emptying cosmos changes rear concealment into an everted human archive.
The exact right-hand parallel changes the book from a neutral record into either a usable credential of return or a back-borne status without agency.
Gathering, covering, inward containment, and uncovering knowledge recast the book as the externalized form of what the recipient had stored within.
summary.what_was_special: The focus construction did not collapse to one symbol: wara and zahr sustained spatial, load-bearing, temporal, epistemic, surface, and postural models, while kitab remained simultaneously writing, decree, enrollment, and assembled trace.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the temporal sense of the far side should remain active in the focus or is only a resonance triggered by the later phase sequence.
Whether the scratch-to-book and hidden-fire mechanisms are intended material analogies or only live cross-domain lexical echoes.
Whether exclusion from belonging is an affordance of rearward receipt or simply a consequence placed beside it.
